name: list_variables
description: List every NuCore variable (integer counter or state flag) in this installation, with its real id/type/precision/current value/init value. Call this before authoring var_ref()/set_var()/while_repeat() inside create_or_update_routine (their id/type/precision must come from here, never invented or guessed), or whenever the customer asks about a variable's existence or current value -- there is no standing database for these, and no other tool reads a variable's current value.

type.description: Optional: 1 (integer variables only) or 2 (state variables only). Omit to list both.
